confirm.description: Confirmation to run a native Cassandra repair.

tables.description: Name of the tables, If no tables given, then the whole keyspace is targeted.

segmentCount.description:
Amount of segments per node to create for the repair run.
@see https://cassandra-reaper.io/docs/configuration/reaper_specific/#:~:text=is%20also%20supported.-,segmentCountPerNode,-Type%3A%20Integer

repairParallelism.description:
Type of parallelism to apply for the repair run.
@see https://cassandra-reaper.io/docs/configuration/reaper_specific/#:~:text=orders%20of%20magnitude.-,repairParallelism,-Type%3A%20String

intensity.description:
Repair intensity for the repair run.
Repair intensity defines the amount of time to sleep between triggering each repair segment while running a repair run.
Value between 0.0 and 1.0, but must never be 0.0.
@see https://cassandra-reaper.io/docs/configuration/reaper_specific/#:~:text=the%20Metrics%20section.-,repairIntensity,-Type%3A%20Float

nodes.description: List of nodes whose tokens should be repaired

blacklistedTables.description: The name of the tables that should not be repaired. Cannot be used in conjunction with the tables parameter.
